{{Quote|Addictive, is it not? The Lignan, I mean.|Saes Rrogon|<ref name="CC" />}}
'''Lignan crystals''' were powerful [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|lightsaber crystals]] crafted from [[Lignan]] [[Ore/Legends|ore]] which enabled the blade of a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] to last longer and burn hotter than normal crystals as well as enhance a dark side user's force powers.

==Description==
Lignan crystals were exceptionally powerful [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|lightsaber crystals]] that were made from [[Lignan]] [[Ore/Legends|ore]]&mdash;an ore that was very powerful in the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]]. Lignan [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]] enabled a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] blade to burn hotter and last far longer than normal lightsaber crystals. This allowed the Lignan-enhanced lightsabers to cut through objects faster&mdash;when a [[Lost Tribe of Sith strike team|strike team]] of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Skirmish at Sinkhole Station|ambushed]] [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiled]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and his son, [[Ben Skywalker|Ben]], they were forced to cut through thick metal doors to reach the Jedi, and the Grand Master attempted to cut an escape hole through the [[Viewport/Legends|viewport]] of the room they were in. However, the Lignan-enhanced lightsabers managed to cut quicker than Skywalker's, and the Sith engaged the Jedi in combat before they could escape.<ref name="Abyss">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Abyss]]''</ref>

==History==
The [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Starship/Legends|starships]] ''[[Omen]]'' and [[Harbinger (Sith dreadnaught)|''Harbinger'']] were [[Mining/Legends|mining]] Lignan ore on [[Phaegon III]]'s [[Phaegon III's largest moon|largest moon]] for [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]] during the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]] in [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]] when they were [[Skirmish over Phaegon III|ambushed]] by the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Relin Druur]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Drev Hassin]].<ref name="CC" /> The ''Omen'' attempted to flee but was knocked off-course after colliding with the ''Harbinger'' just as the former jumped into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].<ref name="Prec" />

The ''Harbinger''{{'s}} [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] was [[Saboteur/Legends|sabotaged]] by Druur and Hassin [[Death/Legends|rammed]] the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] [[Infiltrator (starfighter)|Infiltrator]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] into the ship's [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]], but the crew of the ship attempted to jump into hyperspace anyway. The vessel failed to enter its [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]], and its [[Captain/Legends|Captain]], [[Saes Rrogon]], used the power of the Lignan to hold the ship together as it accidentally [[Time travel/Legends|traveled]] [[Time/Legends|millennia]] into the future, arriving at a secluded [[UR-2212-GR system/Legends|star system]] in [[41 ABY]]. There, Druur [[Mission to the Harbinger|dueled]] with Rrogon and used the Lignan stored aboard the ''Harbinger'' to overpower and kill the Sith Captain and then destroy the ship.<ref name="CC" />

After being knocked off-course, the ''Omen'' crash-landed on the remote [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. Much of the vessel's Lignan ore was salvaged from the crash; and the crystals became valued antiques and a prized symbol of the survivors' Sith heritage. The survivors of the crash were stranded on Kesh, unable to rebuild their ship or contact the outer [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]], so they formed the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]]. The Lignan crystals were used by the Tribe, but they were reserved for only their most powerful members. In 41 ABY, [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Vestara Khai]] was given a lightsaber with a Lignan crystal after she was chosen to be an apprentice by [[Ship (Sith Meditation Sphere)|Ship]], a [[Sith Meditation Sphere]] that discovered the Tribe on Kesh.<ref name="Omen" />

Later, members of the Sith Tribe's [[Lost Tribe of Sith strike team|strike team]] sent to kill Luke Skywalker used Lignan crystal-enhanced lightsabers that allowed them to cut quickly through a metal hatchway at [[Sinkhole Station]], allowing the Sith to engage Skywalker and his son, Ben, before they could cut a hole in the viewport and flee the room.<ref name="Abyss" />
